classification.conclusion_vocabulary: Observed descriptive advantage requires lowerR without higherU at the same M. Any paired bound is assumption-conditional; do not call this confirmed reporting superiority.
classification.denominators: N=held+M; M=S+R+U; R/M,U/M,S/M are null at M0. Report natural allhold/lowcoverage explicitly.
classification.paired_bounds: Existing finite-panel sign-set/risk-difference algebra may be reported conditional on these working intervals. Candidates share signs, models and donors; no independent-pair binomial intervals.

compression_scope: All float64 family and per-fit scored losses, row ordering, allocation ordering and pool membership needed for the reporting comparison are preserved exactly. Raw expression, per-gene predictions, checkpoints, cell identifiers, and repeated per-coverage JSON detail are excluded. This replays saved scores, not model inference.

coverage.attainable_counts: A_j={0} plus every complete prefix-block count of the hard-eligible set for rule j. Common counts A_common are the intersection across all five primary families.
coverage.composition: Publish selected task/pair IDs and composition per rule at each coverage. Different selected subsets at equal M are part of the reporting-policy effect; expose them, and do not compute a test treating them as independent Bernoulli samples.
coverage.fixed_roster: The same N task/model-pair candidates for all five primary families. Report every candidate as direction a/b or hold with reason.
coverage.fixed_threshold_companion: Natural threshold results are a mandatory primary practical-utility display alongside the matched endpoint: each family natural hard-gated coverage, all-hold status, reasons and S/R/U on its actual M. They remain reportable if common matched coverage is empty. Unequal-coverage risk comparisons do not replace or masquerade as the primary matched-coverage comparison.
coverage.hard_holds: A numeric direction tie, unavailable score, failed minimum-gap/stability gate or missing calibration stays held at every matched coverage. Low confidence is not rescued to meet a quota.
coverage.infeasible: If M_star does not exist positively, is below 10 or below 0.25*N, label only the matched-coverage endpoint primary_matched_coverage_not_evaluable. The experiment and natural-coverage utility results remain reportable. A rule issuing zero directions has an observed all_hold/zero_coverage utility failure on this panel, with M=0 and conditional R/M,U/M null. Disclose all scores, penalties, holds and attainable counts; do not loosen the rule. Proceed with previously frozen natural-coverage and secondary evaluations using their original thresholds; no primary substitution or retrospective redesign.
coverage.natural_coverage_failure: Record no_publications as an observed failure to issue directions at the declared confidence/gap/budget, not as missing research or evidence of zero risk. Coverage below the prespecified practical floor is inadequate practical coverage, even when the conditional reversed fraction is zero.
coverage.primary_actual_count: Largest common whole-tie-block count M <= floor(0.5*N). For primary N=63, M<=31; matched endpoint evaluable only if M>=16 (which also exceeds the floor10). For secondary N=504, M<=252 and practical coverage floor126. Natural sets remain reportable at every M, including zero.
coverage.score_ties: For each rule sort eligible reliability scores descending. Values within tau form maximal consecutive blocks; include or exclude an entire block. Do not use task IDs, pair labels, random tie breaking or ceil(q*N) to split a score block.
coverage.secondary_actual_counts: For each target q use max common attainable m<=floor(q*N). Remove duplicate m values, report requested and actual q, and retain m=0 with risk ratios null. No interpolation between attainable points and no claim of equal coverage if counts differ.
coverage.separate_families: Run the coverage algorithm independently for primary N63 and secondary all-context N504. The secondary family includes CD4 Naive but uses its own N504 multiplicity; never substitute it for primary.
coverage.thresholds: Record an explicit threshold interval producing each selected whole-block prefix, the selected IDs and hash. It is acceptable to select thresholds from P scores without A outcomes because the matching algorithm and all directions are frozen before A.

first_two_crossfit_companion.cost: Uncached input forwards16 per state fit/task versus8 anchor and512 fullbank; point caching uses at most16 distinct control forwards per fit/task. Actual cache fills, calibration and score arithmetic separately reported.
first_two_crossfit_companion.estimate: Mean per-seed squared losses across first complementary partition, then equal P donors.
first_two_crossfit_companion.report: Natural coverage and assessment S/R/U using the same primary A64 intervals. At any primary matched M, show this companion only if that exact M is attainable by its own whole-tie prefix; otherwise record unavailable, without forcing ties or replacing M.
first_two_crossfit_companion.role: Prespecified secondary cost companion; not one of five primary families and cannot change common five-rule M.

cross_fitting.equivalence_check: For equal fold sizes and identical arithmetic weights, d_cf equals the repeated_mean_margin companion. Do not fabricate a distinction with different cells, models, seeds or precision. Difference from repeated_splitting primary is the reliability functional (mean margin versus lower allocation quantile).
cross_fitting.estimate: For every unit/task, average already-squared per-seed loss over the two folds of each of the 32 partitions, then across partitions, then across P donor vectors under the stated working model. Subtract mean loss_A from mean loss_B.
cross_fitting.hard_eligibility: Nonzero direction and finite fold-complete scores.
cross_fitting.secondary_cost_frontier: Report the prespecified first-partition (two loss) crossfit and 32-partition version separately; no choosing the better one using A.
cross_fitting.source: Ordinary two-fold crossfit scoring using all cells as input and held-out observed reference in complementary directions.

existing_refara_reporting.calibration_case: Old Parse calibration donor x all eight supported contexts x three matched conditions; 8 donors x 24 tasks = 192 cases, provided adapter verifies complete metadata support. Same seven families, 1968 score genes, B16/T8 and 64 oriented O-half allocations.
existing_refara_reporting.calibration_to_publication_adaptation: The calibration cases are individual C unit x task margins, while a publication candidate is a task margin pooled over P units. The maximum-displacement algebra is unchanged, but this aggregation-level transfer is an explicit prespecified adaptation. Its calibration range is not automatically a valid bound for the new pooled-population estimand. Record both levels and evaluate the rule neutrally.
existing_refara_reporting.calibration_transfer: Record the Parse-to-GSE transfer explicitly. Retain all-hold results caused by this maximum; do not cap, rescale or swap to a GSE-derived penalty after inspecting results.
existing_refara_reporting.estimate: d0_c: the same pooled P anchor margin as score_margin.
existing_refara_reporting.geometry: No automatic geometry_scaled upgrade: only a separate secondary variant if the exact geometry definition and calibration are justified and frozen before P. No post-assessment choice among REFARA variants.
existing_refara_reporting.hard_eligibility: Nonzero direction, complete calibration support for the pair/B, reliability_score > primary_practical_gap + tau.
existing_refara_reporting.historical_non_equivalence: Historical repeated_primary was a calibrated maximum-displacement rule, not the new repeated-splitting quantile. Its old allocation unsupported event is not final interval unresolved.
existing_refara_reporting.penalty: For each of 21 ordered-family pairs, maximum absolute displacement from its case-specific allocation-0 margin over all 192 C cases and all 64 allocations. Reuse this pair penalty unchanged for every GSE task; never fit it on GSE publication or assessment. This is a cross-dataset, individual-case-to-pooled-publication adaptation, not a guaranteed error bound.
existing_refara_reporting.source: Adaptation of current organizer.py _calibrate / repeated_primary empirical-displacement algebra to independent-unit reporting; not an exact reuse of the historical task-level sampling design or old unsupported endpoint.

independent_unit_resampling.bootstrap_unit: For each context independently, sort metadata-eligible P donor IDs, draw np.random.default_rng(20260922).integers(0,n_P,size=(9999,n_P)), and reuse that exact schedule for its 3conditions x21pairs. Primary n_P=16; secondary uses its fixed eligible P roster. Repeat the same seed for each context. No cross-context joint-bootstrap interval is inferred from these publication ranking scores.
independent_unit_resampling.calibration_boundary: Percentile scores are approximate uncertainty summaries, potentially inaccurate under skew, small independent-unit count or rare blocks. Use the declared pre-outcome simulation/precision gate; never choose percentile versus studentized after P/A results.
independent_unit_resampling.constant_and_degenerate_draws: Retain every resample, including zero-variance and all-equal draws. A nonzero constant sample yields its ordinary constant percentile score; do not remove or artificially penalize it. No calibration guarantee follows from that score. A zero mean within tau is a direction tie and remains hold. Final independent assessment supplies the common inferential check.
independent_unit_resampling.estimate: d_boot_c=mean_P_units x_unit,c, where x is the same per-unit crossfit margin.
independent_unit_resampling.hard_eligibility: Nonzero candidate direction, the prespecified minimum P-unit support, finite complete raw unit margins and finite percentile score; score > primary_practical_gap + tau. Do not impose a per-bootstrap-draw SE gate.
independent_unit_resampling.reliability_score: Orient each complete P-unit crossfit-averaged margin by sign_tau(d_boot_c). Resample P donor IDs under the stated working model jointly across all candidates, retaining all nested data, and compute the equal-unit mean for each draw. Score is the empirical 0.05 lower quantile of those oriented bootstrap means: sorted zero-based index floor(0.05*(resamples-1)), no interpolation. This ordinary percentile-bootstrap lower score includes all repeated and constant resamples.
independent_unit_resampling.source: Ordinary whole-independent-unit percentile bootstrap lower-confidence score, using the same crossfit-averaged unit margins. This is a publication-ranking/release baseline, not a claim of calibrated final-assessment coverage.

repeated_splitting.estimate: dbar_c=mean_r mean_P_units margin(unit,c,r), over all 64 oriented splits.
repeated_splitting.hard_eligibility: Nonzero direction and reliability_score > primary_practical_gap + tau.
repeated_splitting.interpretation: Allocation stability score, not an validated donor-population confidence interval or guaranteed coverage probability.
repeated_splitting.reliability_score: For d=sign_tau(dbar_c), take the empirical 0.05 lower quantile of {d*mean_P_units margin(unit,c,r)}. Use order statistic index floor(0.05*(64-1)) in zero-based sorted order, with no interpolation.
repeated_splitting.source: Stability across repeated balanced reference allocations on publication units.
repeated_splitting.strong_companion: Always emit repeated_mean_margin: same dbar direction and abs(dbar) score. With the balanced antithetic bank it is exactly the cross_fitting mean-margin score below. Verify and report this identity rather than omitting the strong averaging baseline or claiming five distinct numerical procedures.

score_margin.estimate: d0_c=mean_P_units margin(unit,c,anchor), using frozen equal-unit/population weights.
score_margin.hard_eligibility: candidate direction nonzero; finite compatible scores.
score_margin.source: Strong simple anchor-margin ranking and threshold baseline.

native_unit_caveat: Rows are donors under a conditional working-independence model within existing experimental pools. Donor identity does not prove independent culture replication; intervals and finite-panel bounds are assumption-conditional diagnostics, not validated coverage guarantees or new-pool inference.

numerical_expected_tolerance.reason: SciPy t-quantiles may differ in final floating-point bits. Decisions use the original strict zero tests, never this comparison tolerance.

pool_sensitivity.held_directions: Publication directions, rule scores, penalties and M remain frozen; never refit rules after excluding pools.
pool_sensitivity.interpretation: Descriptive perturbation of donor composition and shared technical exposure. It changes the assessed donor panel, is not a cluster confidence interval and cannot certify independent new-pool replication. No pool sensitivity replaces the common primary interval.
pool_sensitivity.per_task_exclusion: For each A task and pool, remove donor rows whose control_pool or that condition treated_pool equals the excluded pool. Recompute the donor mean of the same64-allocation margin. Use condition-specific treatment pools, not the union of unrelated task treatment pools.
pool_sensitivity.pool_ids: All12 pool IDs from original donor_split, in numeric order; no outcome-selected pools.
pool_sensitivity.unavailable: If no donors remain, record unavailable without dropping comparison or pool.

primary_assessment.bootstrap_zeroSE: 0/0 becomes0; nonzero/0 becomes signed infinity. Retain all draws. If q is infinite, mark resulting intervals unassessable; do not fall back to narrower t-only.
primary_assessment.constant_missing: Any missing declared donor margin or zero/nonfinite original SE is unassessable. No automatic structural-zero declaration from constant observed margins. This run does not assert identical-function evidence for distinct model families.
primary_assessment.donor_order: Sort donor IDs and comparison IDs before resampling as in the bound mathematical implementation. Bootstrap generator numpy.random.default_rng(20260923), sample donor indices with replacement.
primary_assessment.envelope: min of component lower bounds; max of component upper bounds. Report both components plus envelope.
primary_assessment.formula_maxT: Resample whole A donor vectors jointly across all63 candidates. For each bootstrap T=(bootstrap_mean-original_mean)/bootstrap_SE. Critical q is higher empirical .95 quantile (index ceil(.95*(19999-1))) of max(abs(T)) over original positive-SE assessable candidates.
primary_assessment.formula_t: mean +/- t_(1-.05/(2*63),45)*sample_sd/sqrt(46). Exact classical t calibration would require iid Gaussian donor vectors marginally per contrast; this is not demonstrated here.
primary_assessment.implementation: Reuse reviewed mathematical formulas through an explicitly retrospective wrapper or copied module bound to source hash. Do not label real scores synthetic to bypass the original runner mode guard.
primary_assessment.multiplicity: All63 frozen comparisons, even held/unassessable ones; same interval per comparison for all rules and coverage points.

prior_exposure: All datasets and historical assessment outcomes were used or inspected before this comparison; the original P16/A46 assignment is retained. This is not untouched validation.

rosters.missing_context: Metadata-ineligible donor-context pairs are absent from that task population, not zero losses and not numerical failures. Freeze each task roster before this rerun. All models/rules use exactly the same roster per task.
rosters.secondary_support_boundary: Retain exactly the old complete-three-condition donor-context eligibility blocks: 1017 donor tasks and339 donor-contexts. A wider single-condition-support audit cannot expand this frozen secondary roster.
rosters.task_donor_weighting: Equal donors within each context-condition task, independently for P and A. Do not reuse historical within_donor_weight across different contexts: this study reports per-task comparisons. Each task-pair is one reporting opportunity.
rosters.unexpected_missing: Keep every declared comparison in N; unassessable assessment counts as unresolved for any published direction. A numerical/runtime failure cannot silently shrink the roster.

scope.conditional_model: Treat donor paired-margin vectors as exchangeable, independent observations for a working approximation conditional on fixed models, reference schedule and the observed technical acquisition environment. Shared pools can violate residual independence or exchangeability; this assumption is stated, not established.
scope.previous_result: Preserve the earlier frozen family-selection result: all B16 policies selected PCA, observed loss gain 0%. Reporting reliability is a different endpoint and does not overturn that result.
scope.prior_exposure: All GSE181897 and Parse outcomes belong to disclosed development/retrospective evidence. Recomputed allocations or a preserved historical P/A split do not create untouched validation.
scope.question: Retrospective comparison of five rules for publishing task-specific model-comparison directions at attainable coverage.
scope.scope_limit: No new-pool, new-study, causal treatment or independent-native-experiment claim. Every interval-derived classification and sign-risk bound is a descriptive, assumption-conditional diagnostic; no confirmed superiority or validated nominal coverage claim.
scope.split: Preserve original selection donors as publication P16 and assessment donors as A46; do not reassign. C is old Parse8. Jerber is excluded and remains sealed.

score_contract.Parse_control_membership: Original canonical 144-control order, first16; reuse old validated model point predictions at those same16 controls.

Parse_treated_membership.order: Sort by full SHA256 digest bytes ascending, with obs_index UTF8 bytes as deterministic tie-break; take first8.
Parse_treated_membership.source: Existing Parse cell_axis.tsv.gz; source path and complete digest bound by adapter manifest before freeze.

score_contract.allocation_ids: 0..63; allocation 2*r and 2*r+1 are exact complementary orientation swaps.

allocation_rng.condition_key: No condition key: all three conditions reuse the same context control schedule.
allocation_rng.native_donor: Original donor identity used by the score adapter, with native-to-publication-alias mapping bound in metadata; never swap native donor with public alias without regenerating the schedule contract.
allocation_rng.orientation: 2*r uses permutation[:8] for input/centering and permutation[8:] for observation; 2*r+1 swaps these exact sets
allocation_rng.serialized_key: UTF8 json.dumps([namespace,20260921,partition,native_donor,context,repeat],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(comma,colon)); comma and colon are the literal single-character separators.

score_contract.assessment_target: A uses these same B16/T8 repeated O-half losses. It is not the prior deployment8/all-remaining-target endpoint. Both models always share each allocation target.
score_contract.assessment_vector: x_d,c = mean_r mean_seed L_b(d,c,r,seed) - mean_r mean_seed L_a(d,c,r,seed). Allocations and seeds are averaged within donor; they are never inference rows.
score_contract.control_membership: Existing canonical_control_rank 0..15 per donor/context, merging old control roles in canonical order. All conditions share that context control pool.
score_contract.excluded_family: CPA excluded under the existing frozen cross-platform adapter, not selected by this rerun.
score_contract.loss: Mean_g ((predicted_effect_g - (mean_treated8_g - mean_observation8_g))/training_scale_g)^2. State effect is mean_state_prediction - mean_same_input_controls exactly once; direct effects are unchanged.
score_contract.reference: O-half: input and prediction centre share 8 controls, observed centre uses other8; fixed same treated8.
score_contract.scale: Existing frozen Parse training scales projected onto the same 1968 genes; uniform gene weighting.
score_contract.seed_aggregation: Score each fit separately, then mean losses within family. Never square the mean across seed predictions. Preserve upstream model and centering precision; use float64 loss summaries.
score_contract.treated_membership: Existing canonical within-role treated order first8 per donor/context/condition; Parse uses frozen deterministic source ordering documented by adapter.

secondary_assessment.bootstrap: No maxT on a falsely complete 46x504 matrix; no adaptive method choice. Secondary publication donor-bootstrap ranking is context-specific as defined in five_rules.
secondary_assessment.formula: For each task-pair c use its fixed complete A donor roster n_c: mean_c +/- t_(1-.05/(2*504),n_c-1)*sd_c/sqrt(n_c).
secondary_assessment.missing_constant: Unexpected missing values or nonpositive/nonfinite original SE make c unassessable; retain N504. Metadata-absent contexts never become zero rows.
secondary_assessment.scope: Exploratory all-context working intervals for task-specific eligible donor populations. Small P groups of4 or6 and differing donor populations are reported explicitly. No cross-context population equivalence implied.
